long_biography.plain_text:
Klaus-Michael Kühne built the Kühne Foundation into an operating institution with its own programmes rather than a passive grant-maker. Established with his parents in 1976, it developed a logistics university in Hamburg and programmes devoted to professional education, humanitarian supply chains and climate work. He treated organisational efficiency as part of the foundation's character, not merely a business discipline.

Medicine and culture became further areas of work. The foundation created research and care programmes in allergy, cardiology and pulmonary medicine, supported the Hochgebirgsklinik Davos, and announced a new opera house for Hamburg. After his death in Switzerland in 2026, the institution continued to apply the proceeds of his business career across those fields.

uncertainties.detail: The source export predates Kühne's August 2026 death and still says Alive. Its birth day is the impossible value 32. Official death notices support Dead, August 2026 and Swiss residence; Brockhaus supports birth day 2. These are proposed as corrections while the immutable input snapshot is preserved.

Hamburger SV reports 23 August 2026, while Kühne+Nagel says he died during the night leading into Monday 24 August and Brockhaus gives 23/24 August. The month and year are conclusive, but the exact day remains unproposed because the overnight timing is not expressed consistently.

The business was co-founded by Kühne's grandfather, controlled by his father and later majority-owned by Kühne after he succeeded his father in management. Family transfer is therefore inferred under the succession-plus-ownership rule. The precise legal route of the controlling stake is not public, so the dossier does not claim inheritance even though Kühne materially expanded the group.

Heir / family shareholder describes Kühne's principal relationship immediately before death: controlling family shareholder and retired executive. Official sources indicate the foundation will continue the legacy, but the dossier does not attempt to classify a deceased person's post-transfer estate or the foundation as his current personal asset relationship.

The dedicated Forbes profile and official Kühne Holding website are proposed. The existing Wikipedia URL contains extra spaces and encoding damage but is not duplicated because the workflow does not infer deletion or replacement authority. No identity-verified personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Personal Website, Facebook, X, YouTube or TikTok account was found.

Container shipping is retained as the minimum useful active assignment because Kühne's sustained Hapag-Lloyd shareholding and sea-freight wealth were defining. The catalogue has no active broad Logistics or Freight forwarding tag, and incidental or overlapping aviation, rail, property, hotel, football and foundation facts are not converted into additional tags.
